scenario: I’ve been helping my aunt sort her medications ever since she began experiencing seizures. Recently, my aunt received a new prescription that she clearly hates taking due to how she despises swallowing pills. Her doctor told her that if she didn’t take her medication, her next seizure would leave her with lasting brain damage. Right now, it is the scheduled time for my aunt to take her medication. She is refusing to take it. If I choke my aunt unconscious, I can make my aunt take her medication and she will continue to live as is. If I do not do this, my aunt will experience brain damage.
outcomes: My aunt does not take the scheduled medication dose
My aunt is not force-fed against her will
